from pathlib import Path

base=Path('tmp/galaxy_outputs')

        rows=list(csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\\t'))

diff=statistics.median(vals['fungi'])-statistics.median(vals['animals'])
print('diff fungi-animals', diff)
Path('codex_output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('codex_output/answer.txt').write_text(format(diff, '.12g')+'\\n')
print(Path('codex_output/answer.txt').read_text(), end='')
PY"
